brand.name: Aquafarer
brand.slogan: RIB Boats, Inflatable Boats, SUP Boards Manufacturer & OEM ODM Solution Team
brand.description: Aquafarer is a manufacturer of RIB boats, inflatable boats and SUP boards, providing OEM and ODM solutions to distributors, rental operators, resorts and rescue organisations in 50+ countries. Operating 6 production lines across 12000 m² in Laixi, Qingdao, the factory produces 64 CE-certified models with an annual capacity of 15000 units. Certifications include CE (TÜV Rheinland), ISO 9001:2015 (SGS) and BSCI (Intertek). MOQ starts at 2-5 units for RIB models and 5-10 units for SUP boards.
